questions.question: Why should I perform a soil test before applying fertilizer?
questions.answer: A soil test determines nutrient deficiencies and helps apply the correct fertilizer in the right quantity.

questions.question: What is the difference between organic and chemical fertilizers?
questions.answer: Organic fertilizers improve soil health and release nutrients slowly, while chemical fertilizers provide nutrients quickly for immediate crop growth.

questions.question: Can excess fertilizer damage crops?
questions.answer: Yes. Overuse of fertilizers may burn roots, reduce yield, increase pest attacks, and pollute groundwater.

questions.question: Which fertilizer supplies nitrogen?
questions.answer: Urea is the most commonly used nitrogen fertilizer containing 46% nitrogen.

questions.question: How often should fertilizers be applied?
questions.answer: Application depends on the crop and soil test. Nitrogen fertilizers are usually applied in split doses.
